objective: predict measured mean double-CRISPRi growth gamma for new pairs of supported genes in K562 and Jurkat
split: 60/20/20 train/validation/test canonical gene pairs; same assignment in both contexts, all guides/orientations grouped
candidate: joint shared-plus-private symmetric indefinite low-rank residual completion
primary: mean context-normalized test MSE, using training-only target variances; also require per-context raw MSE gains
secondary: per-context raw MSE and Pearson correlation
replicate agreement MSE as descriptive measurement diagnostic
promotion: at least 2 percent lower test MSE than validation-selected strongest reference in BOTH contexts; paired conditional bootstrap loss-difference upper bounds below zero
no_rescue: one fixed menu and seed; no retuning after test scoring; no expression, cold-gene or independent-lab claim
